title: AI Engineering Hub
summary: A large collection of AI engineering tutorials and mini-projects covering LLMs, RAG, and agents, one of which (sdv-mcp) is an MCP server exposing synthetic-data generation as an agent tool. That tool loads table metadata, fits SDV's HMASynthesizer on real CSV data, samples synthetic output, and calls evaluate_quality to score it.
needs: SDV usage is confined to one of ~93 sub-projects (sdv-mcp) in a huge tutorial monorepo; importance reflects that narrow scope.
